statements.statement: Patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42)
Patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The episodes are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The monitoring is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
